description:
Mesa is building India’s first UG and PG program where you don’t just study business, you actually do business.

✅Learn from founders & leaders of CRED, Meesho, Paytm, Urban Company and more.
✅Test ideas, pitch to investors, raise capital, build your own team.
✅Launch real startups with real customers while you’re still a student.

Not ready to start your own venture yet? Mesa also prepares you for leadership roles at top startups like Swiggy, Zomato, Zepto and Ather.

If you’re ready to build, not just study, check out Mesa School of Business.

#MesaSchoolOfBusiness #BuildNotStudy #Startup
